test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

In an interview at a college, eight people, including the Principal, are sitting in a square formation facing towards the centre, While four of them are seated at the corners, the remaining four are seated at the centre of each side of the square. Bahl is sitting diagonally opposite Nikon. Nikon is sitting to the immediate right of Eva. Pearson is an immediate neighbour of Eva. Pearson is diagonally opposite Charlie. Charlie is seated to the immediate left of the Principal. Philip is not sitting to the immediate right of Bahl. Only three people sit between Philip and Jakson.

Who sits second to the left of Eva?
solution:
Given: eight people, including the Principal, are sitting in a square formation facing towards the centre.

Step 1: Bahl is sitting diagonally opposite Nikon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbdd1a9c53fb263825cb56764448c87c3a24762271168ed76d470eb411ace939.png] 

 

Step 2: Nikon is sitting to the immediate right of Eva.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3368a0b7fc82d8a4406fc5fa3bfdec7fae6a7f68a169d88fcb79d134dff5f9bd.png] 

 

Step 3: Pearson is an immediate neighbour of Eva.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3748c2b8e4723f9ebee8af9e12e484e23da685c5f21a0ddb813daaa1121b896d.png] 

 

Step 4: Pearson is diagonally opposite Charlie.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0843666469f27664570e66987ce372aaa3ca4b1dd4e47ee7afe673cf73614857.png] 

 

Step 5: Charlie is seated to the immediate left of the Principal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/638bcd54e4e8aa7e3e6369c21f0f09a2b4554dccf1ec760b8ad2148f69ef9573.png] 

 

Step 6:Philip is not sitting to the immediate right of Bahl.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bf787ff0f94c279dd07718bc1a161e457127e3f9f7d1d436a8cec7adf2fc0d9.png] 

 

Step 7:Only three people sit between Philip and Jakson.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e589e265f2f1a84ab5aac710f19b6e3a25678ff64d0e9db459abfcf59fe3f19a.png] 

From the figure it can be clearly seen that **second to the left of Eva is Jackson.** 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Jackson"**.
